description: Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation authorizing a non-member @mention campaign. G13 STRUCTURAL: attestingCouncilDids minLength 3 for campaigns ≤50 handles; minLength 4 for campaigns >50 handles. Each campaign MUST cite EITHER memberImpactAttestationCid OR per-recipient externalMentionConsent CIDs (at least one of the two paths). G7 STRUCTURAL: rate limit ≤1 mention / 90d / handle enforced at consent_registry layer.

campaignDescriptionCid.description: IPFS CID of the campaign rationale document; Council reviewers MUST be able to read this before signing

targetHandles.description: AT Proto handles to be @mentioned; muted/blocked handles MUST be filtered BEFORE attestation (G15) — Council attests to the post-filter list

campaignSize.description: G13 STRUCTURAL: ≤50 → attestingCouncilDids minLength 3; >50 → minLength 4; >500 single campaign PROHIBITED at R0-R3

attestingCouncilDids.description: G13 STRUCTURAL: Council Lv6+ DIDs; ≥3 for ≤50-handle campaigns; ≥4 for >50-handle campaigns (validated at consumer)

memberImpactAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of member-impact attestation (documents which members + how impact occurs); EITHER this OR per-recipient consent path required

externalMentionConsentUris.description: AT-URIs of per-recipient externalMentionConsent records; EITHER this OR memberImpactAttestation path required; if both present, both validated

advisoryUri.description: AT-URI of the wellbecomingAdvisory record being dispatched

rateLimitWindowAttested.description: G7 STRUCTURAL: const true; consent_registry confirmed no targetHandle received an ossekai @mention in the trailing 90-day rolling window

expiresAtUtc.description: Council attestation expiration; dispatcher MUST emit before this timestamp or re-attest
